title: Let an outgoing exchange record its publication observation after unrelated local drift
outcome: Let an outgoing exchange record its publication observation after unrelated local drift
acceptance: An exact retry of an already recorded outgoing step returns its original event id before any local planning or branch-head check

After PushStarted, an exact PushObserved (Confirmed or Unknown) is recordable when local planning or the local branch head moved for unrelated reasons; checks that protect what is published (binding, intent, retained commit artifacts and pins) still refuse a mismatch
Tests cover a note or claim added after PushStarted and a later local branch commit, then Confirmed recorded and exact retry returning the same id
